verdict.rationale: Dagster documents a public Python API (dg.asset, AssetExecutionContext), a full-featured `dg` CLI, and dedicated AI-facing surfaces: an official Dagster+ MCP server for taking actions in an AI session and maintained 'dagster-expert' AI skills that give coding agents patterns for building Dagster projects. This directly satisfies an AI-native user's need to drive the product programmatically and via agent tooling. Missing for 10: a documented OpenAPI/REST spec (probe found only 404s) and independent/hands-on confirmation that AI agents successfully use these interfaces in practice.
